name: Prowler Claws
summary: Across the Barrens, Prowler Claws are carried back to Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads. They show that a hunter can track and defeat the prowlers stalking the plains.

sections.title: Trophies of the Stalker
sections.body: Savannah Prowlers hide in the Barrens’ tall grass, waiting to strike with patience and cunning. These large cats ambush creatures that enter their hunting grounds, unlike grazing plainstriders and zhevra. Taking their curved claws means facing predators that rely on stealth and defend their territory. For Horde warriors and scouts, the hunt tests whether they can track a stalker through its own ground and make it the prey.

sections.title: Proof for the Huntress
sections.body: Sergra Darkthorn, the huntress at the Crossroads, asks initiates to bring back Prowler Claws before facing greater trials. The claws show that a hunter can follow tracks through the savannah grass and withstand a predator’s attack. Those who return with them have proved they can stay alert among the dangerous beasts of the plains.

faq.q: Where do I get Prowler Claws?
faq.answer: Savannah Prowlers roam the central Barrens grasslands, especially the plains southwest of the Crossroads. Take their claws and bring them back.

faq.q: Who wants these claws and why?
faq.answer: Sergra Darkthorn, an experienced huntress at the Crossroads, wants seven Prowler Claws. Bringing them to her tests your tracking and fighting against dangerous predators.

faq.q: Why are Savannah Prowlers considered a significant hunt?
faq.answer: Savannah Prowlers are stealthy carnivores that stalk travelers and prey from the tall brush. Hunting them tests whether you can avoid an ambush and defeat a cunning, lethal beast.

angles.text: As a hunter, tracking down savannah prowlers and taking their claws tests your skill at stealth, tracking, and handling beasts at close range.
As a member of the Horde, helping cull prowlers around the Crossroads protects messengers, caravans, and settlers on the central roads of Kalimdor.
